name: Sable Drift
description: An ancient red dwarf drifting through the outer dark with a living world and a dead rock. Eight billion years of calm let the inner world brew simple seas under black skies. The drift's age shows in every cratered face.

stars.name: Sable Dim
stars.description: A red dwarf older than most civilizations' oldest myths, burning low and steady. Its light has not varied measurably in recorded history. Worlds here evolve on billion-year patience.

planets.name: Blacktide
planets.description: A living world under a star too dim for blue skies, its seas black and rich. Microbial reefs build continents of slow carbonate. Two small moons pull tides the reefs set their clocks by.

moons.name: Reefbell
moons.description: A grey moon whose tides ring the reef-building seasons. Marine stations dot its surface, sampling the black seas below. The staff measure time in blooms, not years.

moons.name: Slackwater
moons.description: A small dark moonlet tangling the tides into navigable complexity. Its shadow cools the equatorial reefs each orbit. Fishers time their harvests to its passages.

planets.name: Driftrock
planets.description: A cratered cinder keeping the outer watch, airless and undisturbed. Its far side is the quietest real estate in the system. Relay masts blink here for ships that never come.
